```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  verify_kani:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust (nightly)
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: nightly
          components: rust-src

      - name: Install Kani
        run: cargo install kani

      - name: Run Kani verification on storage crate
        run: cargo kani --features kani -p storage
```
